description: Lumshot is a modern screenshot and visual communication tool for Windows and macOS, designed to make it faster to capture, explain, and share ideas. It combines screen capture, powerful annotation tools, OCR, smart redaction, AI-assisted workflows, and integrations in one desktop app. Capture and annotate screenshots with arrows, shapes, text, highlights, blur, and more.
